description: Timers (40_timers.lua): a wiring smoke test. Scheduling semantics live in timer/ and the lua/ layer.

scenarios.name: a scheduled timer runs its action
timer listings expose the live schedule and show time remaining

steps.type: /lua local t = rune.timer.list()[1]; assert(t.name == "E2E-TIMER-COUNTDOWN"); assert(type(t.remaining) == "number" and t.remaining > 0 and t.remaining <= t.seconds); rune.echo("E2E-TIMER-REMAINING-API")
